title: The Fourth, 2008 · after
logline: The morning after: the lawn chair on the dock with a mug under it, Chloe gone back to Portland at dawn, and Gully looking at the chair the way he looks at the shelf. He leaves it where she moved it. Wood draws where it was and where it is.

panels.composition: The dock in the morning. The lawn chair, moved from under the eave to the planks' edge, a mug under it. GULLY looking at it. WOOD. BARNABY.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a stocky man in an apron looking at an old lawn chair moved to the edge of a dock with a mug beneath it, a thin man and a dog nearby

panels.composition: The pale rectangle under the eave where the chair stood.
